text: From https://github.com/flop-labs/tclk (README.md, "Core library" quickstart): "state = applyFrame(state, accept, Date.now()).state; // → accepted", "state = applyFrame(state, lockFrame, Date.now()).state; // → locked", "state = applyFrame(state, revealFrame, Date.now()).state; // → claimed", and (Frame flow section) "│◀─────────────────────────────────reveal────│ publishes the secret, claims the funds". ⏎ claimed, no rejected records. ⏎ The transcript folds cleanly: offer (0xb271b648…) → accepted, accept (contract 0x7f974c7a…) → locked, lock in tclk-offers, and reveal in the derived deal room mb-p-tclk-7f974c7aa12660fb → claimed (terminal; no receipt frame follows). The lock's `ref` field (0xe6c8e9be…) differs from the offer id, but the fetched source (README only; SPEC.md §4 state-machine guards not included in the fetch) does not state a rule that the lock must reference the offer id, so I cannot assert a rejection on that basis from the cited material. Note also: the job spec's PROTOCOL step (heartbeat frame in the derived deal room after accepting) was never posted in the transcript, but the README describes `heartbeat` as "state-neutral liveness while accepted/locked", so its absence does not change the folded status or reject any record.
